question: ______ is a type of single thin sheet of metal that yields when pressure is applied and is widely used in most modern cars. When pressure is removed, the metal springs back to its original shape.
solution:
The correct answer is __Diaphragm spring.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Diaphragm spring__ is a type of single thin sheet of metal used in most modern cars.
 
• It yields when pressure is applied and springs back to its original shape when the pressure is removed.
 
• This property makes it ideal for automotive applications, especially in clutch mechanisms.
 
• The diaphragm spring ensures smooth and efficient operation in mechanical systems.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cushion spring:**

 
 
• It is used in some applications for providing cushioning effects.
 
• It is not typically used in modern automotive clutches.
 
 
 
• **Leaf spring: **
 
 
• Leaf springs are used in vehicle suspension systems.
 
• They provide support and absorb shocks from road surfaces.
 
 
 
• **Spiral spring:**
 
 
• Spiral springs are used in clocks and measuring instruments.
 
• They store rotational energy rather than linear energy.
